data.title: 'Hostile act': Trump threatens EU with tariffs over Canada associate-membership proposal
data.summary_raw: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said EU is opening the door for Canada to become the first associate member of the 27-member bloc.

data.title: Trump says he still has confidence in Fed Chair Warsh, demands 1% or lower interest rates
data.summary_raw: President Donald Trump previously threatened to cut off trade with countries that have trade surpluses with the U.S. if the Fed doesn't cut interest rates.

data.title: House advances bill to rein in AI data center utility costs
data.summary_raw: The bipartisan legislation would create a regulatory framework states could adopt to prevent data center-related energy costs from being passed on to consumers.

data.title: House votes to hold Leon Black in contempt of Congress over Epstein subpoenas defiance
data.summary_raw: Billionaire Leon Black is suing the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform seeking to block subpoenas it issued him in its probe of Jeffrey Epstein.
